parcel_id.label: parcel_id
parcel_id.desc: City of Toronto parcel identifier. Unique per parcel; the key to join back to source data.

address.label: address
address.desc: Municipal address. Toronto's parcel layer carries no address, so this is matched spatially: an address point inside the parcel, else the nearest within 20 m. Blank on 0.2%.

zone.label: zone
zone.desc: Zone symbol: RD detached, RS semi-detached, RT townhouse, RM multiple, R residential, plus commercial and other zones where the shape filter caught them. Blank on 7%.

frontage_m.label: frontage_m
frontage_m.desc: Lot width at the street. The side of the parcel's minimum rotated rectangle that runs within 45 degrees of the nearest road centreline.

depth_m.label: depth_m
depth_m.desc: The other side of that rectangle.

area_m2.label: area_m2
area_m2.desc: True polygon area, not frontage x depth.

front_setback_m.label: front_setback_m
front_setback_m.desc: Required front yard under the averaging rule 10.5.40.70(1): match or average the abutting buildings within 15 m fronting the same street, with 6.0 m as fallback. Populated on all rows. Median 6.4 m.

side_setback_m.label: side_setback_m
side_setback_m.desc: Required side yard, houseplex rates. R and RT 0.9 m; RD banded on req_frontage_m from 0.6 to 3.0 m; RS banded 0.6 to 1.5 m; RM 1.2 m. Blank in non-residential zones.

rear_setback_m.label: rear_setback_m
rear_setback_m.desc: Required rear yard. R and RT a flat 7.5 m; RD, RS and RM the greater of 7.5 m or 25% of lot depth.

buildable_width_m.label: buildable_width_m
buildable_width_m.desc: frontage_m minus two side yards. The width available to a building. Does not yet account for the wider flankage setback on corner lots.

depth_available_m.label: depth_available_m
depth_available_m.desc: depth_m minus the front and rear yards: the depth available to the MAIN building. The rear yard has already been taken out, and that is where a garden suite goes -- the two do not compete for this space. Sizing a garden suite needs the rear yard left once the main building is placed, which waits on Noam's building depth (17 or 19 m).

max_coverage_pct.label: max_coverage_pct
max_coverage_pct.desc: Maximum share of the lot any building may cover. AN OVERLAY: only 46% of residential lots have one. Where blank the limit comes from the by-law chapter default, which is not published as GIS and is still outstanding.

coverage_cap_m2.label: coverage_cap_m2
coverage_cap_m2.desc: area_m2 x max_coverage_pct. Blank wherever coverage is.

corner_lot.label: corner_lot
corner_lot.desc: Abuts two or more streets, excluding laneways. Corner lots take a wider flankage setback. 4% of residential lots.

lane_access.label: lane_access
lane_access.desc: Abuts a laneway. Separate from corner_lot: a lane at the rear is access, not a corner, and it is what makes a laneway suite possible. 14% of residential lots.

on_major_street.label: on_major_street
on_major_street.desc: Within 30 m of a Major Street. Major Streets switch townhouses and apartments to a different setback regime (window-dependent side yards), not yet modelled. 5% of lots.

building_depth_m.label: building_depth_m
building_depth_m.desc: Depth of the main building: the lesser of the depth between the front and rear yards and the depth at which the footprint reaches 1,400 sq ft. Shortened further where a lot coverage cap binds.

rear_remaining_m.label: rear_remaining_m
rear_remaining_m.desc: Space left between the back of the main building and the rear setback. This is what a garden suite has to fit into.

max_buildable_footprint_sqft.label: max_buildable_footprint_sqft
max_buildable_footprint_sqft.desc: The same footprint in square feet.

garden_suite_storeys.label: garden_suite_storeys
garden_suite_storeys.desc: 0, 1 or 2. One storey needs 9 m of rear space, two storeys 12.5 m. A garden suite does not count against lot coverage.

unit_type.label: unit_type
unit_type.desc: Bachelor through 4 bed, from the architect's size bands. The bands overlap, so a floor is typed as the largest band its area reaches.

n_units.label: n_units
n_units.desc: n_units_main plus one where a garden suite fits.
